/login: Authenticate the browser session before Command Center chrome or live data loads.
/overview: Six live KPIs — requests, error rate, sessions, bytes, exports, latency — refreshed every two seconds.
/topology: Datacenter → cluster → host → datastore map of the configured simulator estate.
/activity: Donut and legend grouping infrastructure traffic by operation class (SOAP, SDK, NFC).
/live-requests: Newest infrastructure HTTP calls with method, path, status, and gateway duration.
/vm-inventory: Searchable, paginated simulator VM table with power state, sizing, datastore, and fixture badge.
/vmdk-library: Fixture `.vmdk` inventory — upload from browser or pick staged host files; optional VM pin.
/scenarios: One-click presets: clean, slow fabric, flaky API, resume export.
/fault-studio: Administrative drawer for latency, status codes, next-N failures, NFC drops, bandwidth cap.
/settings: Read-only listen address plus live admin username/password rotation (no restart).
